result.title: Frequency-Step Cache: Separating Synchronization and Repair for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion
result.summary: Autoregressive (AR) video generation enables long-horizon synthesis but requires repeated forward passes through large diffusion transformers. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reusing intermediate computation, yet existing controllers often couple two decisions: when to synchronize the cache exactly and how much computation to repair between synchronizations. We introduce Frequency-Step Cache (FSC), which separates these roles. FSC schedules exact full-computation anchors on a dense-to-sparse trajectory, while a lightweight latent-space risk based on frequency-resolved drift and token age controls inter-anchor repair through whole-step replay, selective token recomputation, or full repair. On SkyReels-V2, whole-step reuse provides most of the acceleration, while selective token computation is most effective as fidelity repair. A controlled ablation shows that using one reactive signal for both synchronization and repair reduces fidelity at matched latency, with the same separation advantage observed on FramePack and Matrix-Game. Across multiple autoregressive video backbones, FSC improves speed-quality trade-offs. On SkyReels-V2, FSC-Speed reaches 2.36x speedup versus MotionCache's 2.275x while improving SSIM by 0.019 and PSNR by 0.5 dB. At MotionCache-matched speed, FSC-Quality improves SSIM by 0.031 and PSNR by 1.0 dB and lowers LPIPS by 0.024. Without retuning, FSC-Quality transfers to SkyReels-V2 14B at 2.12x speedup versus 1.79x for MotionCache.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Frequency-Step Cache，在自回归视频扩散中把缓存的两类决策解耦：用密集到稀疏的锚点决定何时做全量同步计算，再用基于频域漂移和 token age 的 latent 风险信号决定锚点之间做整步复用、选择性 token 重算还是完全修复，从而改善速度-质量折中。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时同步全量计算、间隔内补多少修复」的两段式调度与基于 latent 漂移/陈旧度的风险度量，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的刷新时机与缓存陈旧修复提供可核查的方法线索；但该工作属视频生成，与推理期状态使用和停止决策的对应关系需人工确认。
